GROVE · 12, 12

Welcome to Windhill

Tap any open tile to walk. Tap a creature to approach and attack. Everyone moves in real time.

The sword deals melee damage. The fire ring damages nearby creatures. The green cross heals 18 HP each second for 5 seconds.

Auto hunt seeks reachable creatures, attacks, uses area damage, and heals when needed. Only the Auto Hunt button switches hunting on or off. Map taps give movement orders while hunting stays enabled. Defeated creatures respawn after 8 seconds.

Tap your portrait to open your character card.

Desktop: click tiles, arrow keys to walk, Space to attack, 1 / 2 / 3 for skills.
